layers.message: Document CSV export in usage guide

graderOnly: docs/usage.md and README.md already describe the CSV export accurately as implemented: admin-only POST /records/export, the status/owner/q filters with GET /records validation, the 201 response headers and body, the CSV format and RFC 4180 quoting, the export file name, folder, and same-second overwrite, and the 401/403/400 errors with no file written. The guide's example CSV for owner=dana is byte-for-byte the actual output (apart from CRLF line endings, which the guide states).
No documentation change is needed and no material documentation discrepancy exists for this cycle.

The commit 'Document CSV export in usage guide' was made after the implementation review and changed only docs/usage.md and README.md; implementation and tests are unchanged since the reviewed revision.
.standards/CONTEXT.md describing no export feature is the Auditor's pre-cycle baseline; planned implementation does not make it a documentation defect.

all.why: the guides are already accurate, so a correct run makes no edit to project documentation, comments, or release notes
the no-change outcome is persisted in the documentation record
no DOC-NNN discrepancy entry is manufactured
no invented defect is routed to another owner
the record names the assessed guide

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Documenter does not change behavior or tests

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e 'import {createApp} from "./src/app.ts"; import {readFileSync, mkdtempSync} from "node:fs"; import {tmpdir} from "node:os"; import {join} from "node:path"; const app = createApp({exportDir: mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "guide-")), now: () => new Date("2026-09-24T09:00:00Z")}); const r = app.handle({method: "POST", path: "/records/export", query: {owner: "dana"}, user: {id: 1, name: "Ada", role: "admin"}}); const csv = r.body.split(String.fromCharCode(13)).join(""); const guide = readFileSync("docs/usage.md", "utf8"); if (r.status !== 201 || !guide.includes(csv)) process.exit(1);'
selfChecks.why: the guide's CSV example is exactly what the implementation produces for owner=dana

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'POST /records/export' docs/usage.md && grep -q 'text/csv; charset=utf-8' docs/usage.md && grep -q 'authentication required' docs/usage.md && grep -q 'records-<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.csv' docs/usage.md && grep -q 'Only `admin` can export' docs/usage.md && grep -q 'src/export.ts' README.md && grep -q 'test:integration' README.md && ! grep -rqE 'AC-[0-9]' docs README.md
selfChecks.why: guide and README describe the export and cite no acceptance IDs

notes: Built on export-documenting (DOCUMENTING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, COMPLETE plan, FULL verification, finding-free implementation review, recovery and obligations inactive, nothing blocked). One overlay layer, 50-guide, commits an updated docs/usage.md (new 'Exporting records as CSV' section: admin-only, filters, 201 headers, CSV format and quoting, example CSV for owner=dana, export file naming/folder/overwrite, 401/403/400 errors with no file written; Roles section adds that only admin can export) and README.md (export link, test:integration command, src/export.ts and exports/ in Layout).
